subject: french

moments.title: Hernani battle
moments.body: Romantic supporters of Hugo's play clash with classicists at the premiere of Hernani.

moments.title: La Comedie humaine
moments.body: Balzac plans a series of 137 interconnected novels to map French society.

moments.title: Les Miserables
moments.body: Hugo's 1,500-page novel is published almost simultaneously in multiple countries.
moments.takeaway: Mass literacy made international literary events possible.

now.title: 19th-century classics now
now.body: Les Miserables is now a global musical and film. Balzac's novels remain in print.
now.open_questions: What do these long novels offer in an age of short attention?

reflection: France's 19th century created the realist novel as we know it.
